Bukas ang mga evacuation center ng mga barangay ng Quezon City para sa QCitizens na apektado ng Bagyong #UwanPH. 

Namahagi na ang Social Services Development Department (SSDD) ng hot meals habang inihanda na ng City Health Department (QCHD) ang doxycycline at tetanus toxoid sa mga evacuees.

Paalala mula sa QCHD: Kung lumusong sa tubig-baha, magtungo agad sa pinakamalapit na health center para makakuha ng doxycycline bilang proteksyon laban sa leptospirosis.

Mag-ingat lagi, QCitizens!

data.text:
#MSNews | Personnel of the Catbalogan City Fire Station retrieved a cadaver trapped beneath the debris of her destroyed residence at Pier 2, Barangay 3, Catbalogan City, following the devastation brought by Super Typhoon "Uwan."

Upon receiving the report, BFP Catbalogan immediately dispatched a response team to the area to conduct search and retrieval operations.

"We continue to stand in solidarity with all those affected by the recent typhoon and remain committed to providing assistance and emergency response to our fellow Catbalogans in this time of crisis," the Catbalogan Fire Station said in their statement. | via Vince Lopez

📷 Catbalogan City Fire Station

For more info, visit https://t.co/rmQCnNSgGa.
